messages:
Sam Sales: Quick heads-up - MerchantPayments (legal + infra) want a BYO-key POC. They need: CMK in customer KMS (CloudHSM), HSM attestation report, and a 30/90-day rotation demo. Can we do a POC that proves keys never leave their HSM? @Erin Security can you confirm the wording we can share with them?
Erin Security: We can confirm we support customer-managed keys and we never export key material from a supported HSM. Need to clarify: they want key material never seen by Redwood vs never exported - subtle difference.
Sam Sales: They explicitly said "never seen by third parties" in the RFP. Also asking if rotation can be automated from their end or must pass through Redwood.
Jason Eng: Technically we support two flows: 1) Redwood references the external KMS via KMIP/CloudHSM and never stores keys; 2) Customer uploads a wrapped KEK to our keystore and we unwrap in HSM - latter is harder. For a short POC #1 is cleanest.
Matt SRE: For flow #1 we'll make KMS calls on every sign/encrypt. Latency impact depends on call rate; recommend caching a short-lived delegated key or using per-request envelope keys. Need SLA discussion.
Sam Sales: They're very sensitive to latency for inference (sub-150ms). Any ballpark on HSM call cost and added latency?
Jason Eng: CloudHSM 1-2ms for local ops, network adds 10-40ms depending on region. If they expect high QPS we should propose a hybrid: prefix/KV cache plus per-token envelope keys. I can draft a diagram.
Ali Solutions: I can propose a POC scope: 1) Validate attestation (we pull attestation doc), 2) Setup Redwood pointing to their HSM in staging, 3) Run a rotation where they initiate a 30-day rotate, 4) Measure latency and error modes. POC timeline: 2 weeks if infra available.
Sam Sales: Pricing question from procurement: any per-KMS-call fees vs included in Dedicated reserved capacity? Also who pays for HSM hours?
Erin Security: Security note: we'll need an NDA addendum to include key-handling assurances and an audit window. Also KMS audit logs need to be forwarded to their SIEM or we provide logs for review.
Jason Eng: On pricing: KMS calls typically bill on customer side (they own the HSM). Our Dedicated offering adds no per-KMS surcharge; we count associated CPU/GPU for inference. If we act as a proxy and store wrapped keys we may add a small per-rotation admin charge in SOW.
Sam Sales: OK. Can someone draft a short FAQ blurb I can pass to procurement? They want clear answers on: key ownership, attestation, rotation trigger source, latency impact, and who bears HSM costs.
Ali Solutions: I'll draft the FAQ. Quick Q: for attestation proof, do we accept vendor-signed attestation PDFs + chain, or need live attestation validation?
Erin Security: Vendor-signed attestation + certificate chain is acceptable for POC. For enterprise contract we prefer periodic live attestation or audit statements.
Jason Eng: For the demo rotation I'll show a scripted rotation endpoint:
````
# agent triggers rotation
curl -X POST https://pi.redwood.ai/v1/admin/rotate-key -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"key_id":"cmk-1234","rotation_source":"customer-hsm"}'
````
This will call their KMS to generate a new wrapping key then atomically swap. We'll capture metrics.
Matt SRE: Also add failure mode test: HSM unavailable -> fallback to read-only cached key for 5s then fail. Need agreement from infra on acceptable fallback window.
Sam Sales: Great. Action items: Ali to draft procurement FAQ + POC SOW, Jason to prepare demo script and latency test plan, Erin to confirm security wording + NDA addendum. I'll schedule a kickoff with their infra lead for Wed.
DeployBot: [deploy] Created staging cluster 'merchant-payments-poc' (id: stg-5632) - ready for onboarding. :rocket: 
Sam Sales: Perfect - I'll share the FAQ and probe on HSM hosting (customer-managed vs colocated) in kickoff.
